description: The demo scenarios and the preconditions "demo check" proves before a demo. The catalog is src/docs/demo/scenarios.md, and each scenario's presenter script is in src/docs/demo/scenarios (script). S-01 to S-16 are the guided story of src/docs/demo/run-15-minutes.md, in its order of IDs; story is the time slot in that run. S-17 to S-23 are the deep-dive scenarios of run-45-minutes.md (story null); S-22 and S-23 play last, after every other scenario, because each of their steps writes. spec is the end-to-end spec in src/tests/e2e, whose test titles start with the step IDs of the script. Each precondition is what must hold on a fresh store after the demo director, before anyone plays the scenario. Every name is fictional.
